purpose: Winner-independent split of the dominant upstream sampling/traversal instability into exact deck/chance schedule randomness versus collector stochastic traversal/action sampling randomness.

factorial.deck_axis: Only the deterministic exact solver deck schedule changes. stage.deck_seed is rebound to production deck_seed(deck_seed, global_root, iteration).
factorial.traversal_axis: Only collector stochastic action/path draws change through an independent random.Random(traversal_seed XOR 0xC0FFEE).
factorial.learning_axis: Advantage initialization/reset, side ensemble, optimizer minibatches, reservoir replacement and bundle batch RNG remain fixed at learning seed 1801739323.
factorial.final_policy_axis: One common final AveragePolicy learner seed 1538612375 is used for every cell, identical to the prior upstream-factorial diagnostic readout.

contrasts.different_deck_same_traversal: Hold traversal RNG fixed and compare the two independent deck/chance schedules.
contrasts.same_deck_different_traversal: Hold exact deck/chance schedule fixed and compare the two independent collector stochastic traversal RNG streams.

precommitted_interpretation.deck_dominant: DECK_CHANCE_DOMINANT only if deck mean-of-mean TV >= 1.20x traversal mean-of-mean TV AND deck mean-of-p95 TV >= 1.20x traversal mean-of-p95 TV.
precommitted_interpretation.traversal_dominant: TRAVERSAL_ACTION_SAMPLING_DOMINANT only under the symmetric 1.20x condition on both aggregate metrics.
precommitted_interpretation.otherwise: BOTH_MATERIAL_OR_INTERACTION; do not choose a subcomponent post hoc.
precommitted_interpretation.deck_next_action: Freeze a chance-coverage stabilization experiment that preserves independent chance seeds while increasing and/or stratifying deck coverage; do not make both training seeds share the same chance schedule merely to pass stability.
precommitted_interpretation.traversal_next_action: Freeze a variance-reduced traversal experiment that preserves unbiased policy sampling while reducing stochastic path variance.
precommitted_interpretation.both_next_action: Freeze either a replicated split on the other learning seed or a joint variance-reduction experiment, with the choice itself frozen before outputs.
